headline: TCS, NMDC, and PTC India among companies announcing dividends, bonuses, and splits in October
hook: Corporate actions lined up for October
summary: Several major Indian companies have announced corporate actions including dividends, bonuses, stock splits, and buybacks scheduled for October. Key firms listed include Tata Consultancy Services (TCS), NMDC, PTC India, and JSW Dulux. Retail investors holding these stocks need to track record dates and ex-dividend dates to be eligible for these payouts and corporate benefits. These events temporarily impact stock liquidity and price adjustments post-ex-date.
whats_next: October ex-dates and record dates for respective companies
why_it_matters: Track ex-dates to claim upcoming dividends or bonus shares

headline: PTC India submits AGM scrutinizer report and voting results
hook: AGM voting results now on record
summary: PTC India Limited has submitted the scrutinizer's report and voting results of its Annual General Meeting held on September 30, 2026, to the stock exchange. Routine compliance filings such as AGM voting results do not alter the company's financial standing or share price directly. For an Indian retail investor, this is standard corporate governance reporting with no immediate impact on investment value.
why_it_matters: Routine compliance update with no financial impact

headline: Small-cap dividend gems: Nine stocks offer yields of up to 16%
hook: High payouts among lesser known names
summary: Majestic Auto announced a dividend of ₹60 per share for FY 2025-26, translating to a 16.8% yield as shares rose 1.37% to ₹370 with a market cap of ₹384.71 crore. Indo Borax shares fell 3.23% while offering a ₹40 per share dividend yielding 7.9%. Other featured stocks in the list include Premco, PTC India, and Honda Power. These micro and small-cap yields offer alternative income streams for retail investors tracking high-dividend options.
why_it_matters: High dividend yields provide cash returns from small-cap holdings.
winners_losers: Dividend-focused retail investors gain / micro-cap volatility risks apply
